edits.value_json: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. 字源 p. 885 cautiously names 火星 without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the CUHK 火 and 晶 entries identify the historical star name as 大火/心宿二. The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or establish a semantic connection with literal ‘fire’.
